description: Configs for grid_substrate_runner research. Each config = (host_shell, expression). Renders one in-game screenshot of the runner mounted on the host shell with that single expression active.

configs.notes: Buren-on-Soane: visible only on plinth tops. The plinth field becomes a striped column array via height-aware visibility.
Inverse of atop_plinths — the plaza, the path. Plinths vanish, the walkable space lights up.
Every 3rd walkable cell. Array indexing made visible through visibility, restricted to floor only.
The skirt around the plinth field — walkable cells that touch a plinth. The boundary the player navigates.
Every walkable cell visible. The dense cartridge — sets up contrast against stride/perimeter.
Same expression on an organic shell — the same code reads as a totally different pattern when the host changes.
Same expression on the simplest possible shell. Establishes the baseline.
Index [0] only — one plinth lit. The array's first element. The minimal pattern that proves the array is indexed at all.
Indices 0, 2, 4, … — alternating plinths in row-major order. The simplest rhythm. Same plinth array, every other one selected.
Indices 0, 3, 6, … — slower disco beat. Stride three across the plinth list.
Indices 1, 3, 5, … — the offbeat. Pair with every_2nd to see the complement.
Indices 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, … — exponential indexing. Computational thinking rendered as a sparse array.
Indices that are prime (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, …). Number theory as spatial pattern.
Disco beat: plinths where (row + col) mod 4 == 0. Diagonal phase bands across the field — the now-playing beat of the array.
Disco offbeat: (row + col) mod 4 == 2. Complement of disco — together they tile the plinths in two interleaved phases. Two clocks, one face.
